name: Darkcore the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, travelers find Darkcore the Elder in the Undercity and honor Azeroth's ancient spirits. In return, they receive a Coin of Ancestry.

sections.title: A Spirit in the Undercity
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits of ancient night elven and earthen ancestors appear across the continents. They offer wisdom and blessings to those who seek them. Elder Darkcore dwells in the Undercity's shadowed halls, watching the world as it is now and remembering those who sought its roots.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestors
sections.body: Approaching Elder Darkcore honors an ancient custom. It shows respect for the venerable dead and Azeroth's timeless wardens. In return for the pilgrimage, the spirit gives travelers a Coin of Ancestry, a token of goodwill and enduring memory.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Darkcore?
faq.answer: Visiting Elder Darkcore during the Lunar Festival honors Azeroth's ancient peoples. Speaking with him earns a Coin of Ancestry.

faq.q: Where can Elder Darkcore be found?
faq.answer: Elder Darkcore appears in Lordaeron's ruined throne room, above the Forsaken capital of the Undercity.
The Lunar Festival is an annual time of remembrance and renewal across Azeroth. It celebrates the triumph over the Burning Legion and honors ancient elders who guided mortal races.
Elders are ancient spirits often tied to the night elves or early earthen cultures. During the Lunar Festival, they appear to bless those who remember their deeds and carry their lessons forward.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak to Elder Darkcore?
faq.answer: Elder Darkcore greets any traveler who reaches him. Alliance travelers must brave the heavily defended Forsaken capital to speak with him.

faq.q: What is a Coin of Ancestry?
faq.answer: A Coin of Ancestry is a festive token given by elders during the Lunar Festival. It honors the ancient past and can be traded for festive garb and seasonal keepsakes.

angles.text: For the Forsaken who walk the ruins of their former kingdom, Elder Darkcore recalls older times, before the Scourge and Lordaeron's fall.
As a member of the Horde, you can take part in the Lunar Festival's rites across the continents within an allied capital.
